result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months’ amounts and USD 1,000,000, preserves a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, and includes all preferred uncapped carve-outs. It therefore reaches the playbook position. However, it goes beyond the required Customer payment-obligation clarification by excluding amounts owed by either Party under Section 5, potentially leaving supplier payment obligations uncapped. It also measures the lookback from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim itself and expands the cap base to revenue-share amounts. Finally, the existing malformed punctuation (“REPRESENTATIVES„”) remains, so the rendered clause is not professionally finalized.
